name: Banh duc nong
summary: Bánh đúc nóng is a hot steamed cake of plain rice and tapioca flour. Vietnam Tourism fills it with black fungus, meat, and fried shallots, and serves it with chilli-garlic fish sauce and herbs.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article sends you to it on a cold winter afternoon. Ninh Bình’s bánh đúc is a different plate.
texture: Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article calls the cake hot and soft.
howToEat: Rice and tapioca flour, stirred to a set cake, with black fungus, meat, and fried shallots. Chilli-garlic fish sauce and herbs come with it.
Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article calls it an afternoon snack on a cold day.
where: Vietnam Tourism’s stadium note names a bánh đúc door at 45 Châu Long, Quán Thánh, Ba Đình. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh duc nong — Hanoi hot rice cake
seoDescription: Bánh đúc nóng in Hanoi is a steamed rice-and-tapioca cake with black fungus, meat, and fried shallots, eaten with chilli-garlic fish sauce. One door is 45 Châu Long.
